The in-binary Timer is not thread-safe, so a stage covering parallel work is indicative, not exact.

sampling.foreign_definition: CPU actually consumed between consecutive samples by processes outside this run's own subtree, from /proc/<pid>/stat utime+stime deltas. Username cannot be used here: concurrent round workers and ctffind all run as the same user. ps pcpu cannot be used either: it is a lifetime average and does not resolve activity during the run. Ownership is by session id, not by a walked process tree, which races with the sampler's own subprocesses. in-mask counts only threads in state R.
sampling.vram_note: NVML sampled at this period; a sampled peak is a lower bound on the true peak and is not the allocator-traced peak.
